summary: Added docshelf/access.py (Rules plus role, suspended, is_admin, acting_for, can_read, can_write, can_share, can_delete) and moved every access check out of listing, show, edit, share, delete and audit, each now with a module-level RULES. The existing tests and the new tests/test_access.py pass, and a differential fuzz of 18,000 command runs against the original package gave identical stdout, stderr, exit status and workspace files. The quirks the copies disagreed on (role case, suspension end day, grant and delegation end minute, blank teams, wildcard grants, delegate rights) were kept as they are and not fixed.
